name: Tonight hook words
desc: Spoken female hook words - tonight, electric, paradise, higher - chopped and pitched into a nu-disco vocal riff with echo throws. TTS-sourced so it works as a rhythmic hook; the groove must survive without it (external service at load).

code.full: s("<tonight electric paradise higher>").struct("x ~ [~ x] ~").gain(${gain}).speed("<1 1.05 .95 1>").room(.35).delay(${echo}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.3).hpf(180).pan(cosine.range(.44,.56).slow(8)).lastOf(4, x=>x.chop(4).speed(1.1)).orbit(8).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<tonight electric paradise higher>").struct("x ~ [~ x] [~ x]").gain(${gain}).speed("<1 1.05 .95 1.1>"), s("<deeper breathe>").struct("[~ ~ ~ x]").chop(2).gain(${gain}*.7).speed(1.15).pan(.62).mask("<0 1 1 1>")).room(.32).delay(${echo}).delaytime(.25).delayfeedback(.35).hpf(180).orbit(8).play()
